description: Unique, stable identifier. Primary key.
Common English name of the conflict.
Pipe-separated alternative names, or the literal placeholder 'None documented' if none is commonly used.
Conventional start date.
End date, or the literal string 'ONGOING' for the 13 conflicts still active as of last_verified_date. ALWAYS check is_ongoing (boolean) rather than string-matching this column in code.
Days from start_date to end_date, OR to the dataset's as-of date (2026-07-07) for ongoing conflicts. See duration_is_provisional.
duration_days_to_date / 365.25.
True = conflict is ongoing, so duration_days_to_date is a running total, NOT a final duration. False = conflict ended and the duration is final.
Free-text status description.
Authoritative ongoing/ended flag. Use this, not string-matching end_date.
Country/entity display names.
Count of entries in countries_involved.
Geographic region(s).
Representative cities, or 'Not documented' placeholder.
Latitude of one representative point.
Longitude of one representative point.
One side/coalition, or the literal placeholder 'Not delineated into two sides (see military_alliances_raw)' where the conflict doesn't reduce to two sides.
Other side/coalition. Same placeholder policy as side_a.
Full unparsed alliance description, or 'Not documented as a formal two-sided alliance structure'.
Paraphrased summary of principal cause(s).
Conflict typology (Correlates of War / UCDP-aligned).
Low-end military/combatant death estimate.
High-end military/combatant death estimate.
Low-end civilian death estimate.
High-end civilian death estimate.
Low-end total death estimate (not always == military_low + civilian_low; see notes in v1.0.0 README).
High-end total death estimate.
Single central estimate for convenience in charts. Prefer the range for analysis.
Explains why the range is wide / what's included, or the placeholder 'Single broadly-agreed figure in cited sources; no material dispute to note' where sources agree closely.
Estimated cross-border refugees. **-1 means 'not reported' — it is NOT a real value.** Always check refugees_reported before using this column numerically.
True if refugees holds a real sourced figure; False if it holds the -1 sentinel.
Estimated IDPs. Same -1 sentinel policy as refugees.
True if internally_displaced_persons holds a real figure.
Low-end direct economic/reconstruction cost in USD, NOT inflation-adjusted across eras. -1 = not reported (populated for only 3 of 106 conflicts — see economic_damage_reported).
High-end economic damage estimate.

True if a real sourced economic-damage figure exists for this conflict (3 of 106 rows). ALWAYS filter on this before aggregating economic_damage_usd_* — the -1 sentinels will silently wreck a SUM() or MEAN() otherwise.
Explains what the figure covers / inflation-adjustment status / why none exists.
Free-text description, or 'Not systematically documented' placeholder.
Name/date of the ending treaty or agreement, with explicit context where none exists (e.g. 'None (no formal treaty; ended by British military suppression)').

Distinct ceasefire date where one exists separate from end_date. Placeholder is the literal string 'Not Applicable' (NOT 'N/A' — deliberately avoided because pandas silently reads a bare 'N/A' as NaN on default CSV parsing; see validation_report.md).
True if ceasefire_date holds a real date (9 of 106 rows).
Paraphrased summary of the conflict's outcome.
Confidence tier — see README.md for full tier definitions.
